title: Thai-Style Carnaroli Risotto
description: A creamy and flavorful risotto infused with Thai-inspired flavors, featuring zesty som tam sauce.
instructions: Heat the vegetable broth in a separate pot and keep warm.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the Thai red curry paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the Carnaroli rice and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the coconut milk and stir to combine.
Add 1 cup of the warm broth to the rice mixture and stir to combine.
Continue adding the broth, 1 cup at a time, stirring constantly and allowing each portion to absorb before adding the next.
After 20-25 minutes of cooking, the rice should be tender and creamy.
Stir in the zesty som tam sauce and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Serve the risotto hot, garnished with fresh cilantro and lime wedges.
